sql: SELECT 'Fire_Weather' AS src, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT incident_number) AS n_inc, COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS n_states FROM Fire_Weather_Data_2002_2014_2016 UNION ALL SELECT 'noaa_wildfires', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT incident_number), COUNT(DISTINCT state) FROM noaa_wildfires UNION ALL SELECT 'fires_by_state', COUNT(*), SUM("Total Fires"), COUNT(DISTINCT State) FROM Wildfire_Fires_by_State UNION ALL SELECT 'p45_54', COUNT(*), SUM("Total Fires"), COUNT(DISTINCT State) FROM wildfire_total_fires_p45_54

SELECT 'Fire_Weather' AS src, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS n, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT incident_number) AS DOUBLE) AS n_inc, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS DOUBLE) AS n_states FROM Fire_Weather_Data_2002_2014_2016 UNION ALL SELECT 'noaa_wildfires', CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT incident_number) AS DOUBLE), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS DOUBLE) FROM noaa_wildfires UNION ALL SELECT 'fires_by_state', CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE), CAST(SUM("Total Fires") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT State) AS DOUBLE) FROM Wildfire_Fires_by_State UNION ALL SELECT 'p45_54', CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE), CAST(SUM("Total Fires") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT State) AS DOUBLE) FROM wildfire_total_fires_p45_54

SELECT 'Fire_Weather' AS src, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS n, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT incident_number) AS VARCHAR) AS n_inc, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS VARCHAR) AS n_states FROM Fire_Weather_Data_2002_2014_2016
SELECT 'noaa_wildfires' AS src, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS n, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT incident_number) AS VARCHAR) AS n_inc, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT state) AS VARCHAR) AS n_states FROM noaa_wildfires
SELECT 'fires_by_state' AS src, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS n, CAST(SUM("Total Fires") AS VARCHAR) AS sum_fires, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT State) AS VARCHAR) AS n_states FROM Wildfire_Fires_by_State
SELECT 'p45_54' AS src, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS n, CAST(SUM("Total Fires") AS VARCHAR) AS sum_fires, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT State) AS VARCHAR) AS n_states FROM wildfire_total_fires_p45_54
SELECT state, usa_state, CAST(DEM AS VARCHAR) AS dem, CAST(REP AS VARCHAR) AS rep, CAST(percent_democrat AS VARCHAR) AS pct_dem FROM democratic_vs_republican_votes_by_usa_state_2020 ORDER BY state
SELECT 'fires_by_state' AS src, State AS state, CAST("Total Fires" AS VARCHAR) AS total_fires FROM Wildfire_Fires_by_State ORDER BY State LIMIT 50

WITH party AS ( SELECT usa_state, CASE WHEN DEM > REP THEN 'Democratic' ELSE 'Republican' END AS party FROM democratic_vs_republican_votes_by_usa_state_2020 WHERE usa_state <> 'District of Columbia' ), f37 AS ( SELECT p.party AS party, CAST(SUM(f."Total Fires") AS VARCHAR) AS n_fires FROM Wildfire_Fires_by_State f JOIN party p ON f.State = p.usa_state GROUP BY 1 ), f50 AS ( SELECT p.party AS party, CAST(SUM(f."Total Fires") AS VARCHAR) AS n_fires FROM wildfire_total_fires_p45_54 f JOIN party p ON f.State = p.usa_state GROUP BY 1 ), unmatched37 AS ( SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS unmatched FROM Wildfire_Fires_by_State f WHERE f.State NOT IN (SELECT usa_state FROM party) ), unmatched50 AS ( SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS unmatched FROM wildfire_total_fires_p45_54 f WHERE f.State NOT IN (SELECT usa_state FROM party) ) SELECT 'fires_by_state' AS src, party, n_fires FROM f37 UNION ALL SELECT 'p45_54', party, n_fires FROM f50 UNION ALL SELECT 'fires_by_state_unmatched', 'NA', (SELECT unmatched FROM unmatched37) UNION ALL SELECT 'p45_54_unmatched', 'NA', (SELECT unmatched FROM unmatched50)

WITH party AS ( SELECT usa_state, CASE WHEN DEM > REP THEN 'Democratic' ELSE 'Republican' END AS party FROM democratic_vs_republican_votes_by_usa_state_2020 WHERE usa_state <> 'District of Columbia' ) SELECT 'state_incidents' AS src, p.party AS party, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT f.incident_number) AS VARCHAR) AS n_fires, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT f.state) AS VARCHAR) AS n_states FROM Fire_Weather_Data_2002_2014_2016 f JOIN party p ON f.state = p.usa_state GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
SELECT state, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS n FROM Fire_Weather_Data_2002_2014_2016 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT State, CAST("Total Fires" AS VARCHAR) AS total_fires FROM wildfire_total_fires_p45_54 ORDER BY "Total Fires" DESC

WITH party AS ( SELECT usa_state_code, CASE WHEN DEM > REP THEN 'Democratic' ELSE 'Republican' END AS party FROM democratic_vs_republican_votes_by_usa_state_2020 ) SELECT p.party AS party, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT f.incident_number) AS VARCHAR) AS n_fires, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT f.state) AS VARCHAR) AS n_states FROM Fire_Weather_Data_2002_2014_2016 f JOIN party p ON f.state = p.usa_state_code GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH party AS ( SELECT usa_state_code, CASE WHEN DEM > REP THEN 'Democratic' ELSE 'Republican' END AS party FROM democratic_vs_republican_votes_by_usa_state_2020 ) SELECT p.party AS party, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS n_states FROM party p WHERE p.usa_state_code IN (SELECT DISTINCT state FROM Fire_Weather_Data_2002_2014_2016) GROUP BY 1

WITH party AS ( SELECT usa_state_code, CASE WHEN DEM > REP THEN 'Democratic' ELSE 'Republican' END AS party FROM democratic_vs_republican_votes_by_usa_state_2020 ) SELECT f.state, p.party, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS n FROM Fire_Weather_Data_2002_2014_2016 f JOIN party p ON f.state = p.usa_state_code GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH party AS ( SELECT usa_state_code, CASE WHEN DEM > REP THEN 'Democratic' ELSE 'Republican' END AS party FROM democratic_vs_republican_votes_by_usa_state_2020 ), counts AS ( SELECT p.party AS party, COUNT(DISTINCT f.incident_number) AS n FROM Fire_Weather_Data_2002_2014_2016 f JOIN party p ON f.state = p.usa_state_code GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN party = 'Democratic' THEN n END) AS VARCHAR) AS democratic_fires, CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN party = 'Republican' THEN n END) AS VARCHAR) AS republican_fires FROM counts

WITH party AS ( SELECT usa_state_code, CASE WHEN DEM > REP THEN 'Democratic' ELSE 'Republican' END AS party FROM democratic_vs_republican_votes_by_usa_state_2020 ), counts AS ( SELECT p.party AS party, COUNT(DISTINCT f.incident_number) AS n FROM Fire_Weather_Data_2002_2014_2016 f JOIN party p ON f.state = p.usa_state_code GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN party = 'Democratic' THEN n END) AS DOUBLE) AS democratic_fires, CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN party = 'Republican' THEN n END) AS DOUBLE) AS republican_fires FROM counts
